ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. NOTE: This is a course trip to Rome, Italy. All international paperwork has been submitted back in October 2006. There are fees for the travel and lodging that are extra. Additional travel costs for airfare, lodging and food are not included in the fees listed. This is open to any student degree or non-degree grads and undergrads.
